Method of Attack: Backdoor malware with modular architecture allowing second-stage modules
Takes screenshots and sends them to the attacker's server
Enumerates running processes and sends process info to the server
Sends list of documents with specific extensions to the attacker
Runs files as instructed by the attacker
Logs system details and sends them to the server
Deletes payload from startup and removes actual file
Sends list of disk partitions found on infected machine
Impacted Systems: Windows workstations of Palestinian law enforcement and Palestinian government officials
Attack Vector: Spear-phishing emails with self-extracting archive executable attachments disguised with Word-like icons
